headline: Novaya Gazeta Says It Was Forced to Stop as Italian and Dock Workers Act
deck: A Russian newspaper says authorities forced it to stop, while labor actions in Italy and at ports press separate demands.
body: Novaya Gazeta said Russian authorities and security services had forced the paper to stop its work. [E1]
CNN reported that tens of thousands of people in Italy protested rising living costs and weak public services. [E2]
USB led the nationwide action, which included workers in public and private sectors, CNN reported. [E3]

Dockworkers would hold coordinated strikes and demonstrations at more than 100 ports in 17 countries on 30 October under an anti-war and anti-militarisation banner, the International Transport Workers’ Federation said. [E4]
The federation said participating unions also sought better pay and working conditions and opposed increasing automation. [E5]
